content: abstract slots only; no utterance text, entity words, state words or gold strings

balance.statistic: bias-corrected Cramer's V (Bergsma 2013); uncorrected row-level V reported
balance.family: rows sharing (unit, stratum, construction): one paraphrase family, one meaning
balance.within: aspect (fire punctual; move, scan, hold, wait durative) x measure (F3 measured, F4 count, other F cells plain)
balance.rows: F-cell rows (stratum F1-F12), detection-arm rows excluded
balance.min_rows_applies_to: rows in the stratum within the scope
balance.decision: fail when the bias-corrected V exceeds the tolerance on any table in a decisive scope
balance.resolution: each table reports the corrected V a chi-square at its 95th percentile under independence produces; a pass where that exceeds the tolerance means no association beyond chance was detected, and is listed as unresolved

detection_arm.removal: drop every row with arm == true; no other row moves

reserved_vocabulary.rule: a reserved row's entity and state words come only from the sealed reserved list; set on whole units (a family or pair shares its words)

probe_reserve_pool.rule: written before the probe first runs; never inspected; drawn only for the s5.2 rule (b) re-test (CA14-2)
probe_reserve_pool.strata: F, B, D, PC-2, cap boundary
